text:
Maria G.: kicking off deploy window for release v2.4.1 — feature flag plan below, deploying at 02:00 UTC. keep alerts open please.

Maria G.: FF: `new-model-routing` will be toggled by deploy-bot in cohorts: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with 10m soak between steps. pin to prior model if we see >2% error rate uplift or latency +50ms p95.

dev-deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: v2.4.1 to infra-prod at 2025-01-18T02:00:00Z. Automated FF toggles enabled. See run-id: run-1749298765.

Raj P.: noted. what telemetry gates are we using? cpu? 5xx? token-cost spike?

Maria G.: primary gates: 5xx rate (service), p95 latency (endpoint), model-quality regression (eval set mismatch). secondary: token-per-request delta >15%.

Sophie L.: logging how we check model-quality — we'll run the sampling eval job `runtest/eval-sampler --cohort new-model-routing` after each step. will post results in 5m.

Ops Oncall: alert thresholds set. I'll keep paging window open for 03:30 UTC in case of slow rollbacks.

Taylor H.: quick note on pinning procedure: if we need to pin, run:```sh
rbx flag pin new-model-routing --version=stable-2.3.9 --reason="rollback:telemetry"
rbx deploy rollback --run-id=run-1749298765
```

Raj P.: good. Also watch routing shard saturation — if queue length >2000 on any shard, hold and investigate.

dev-deploy-bot: Step 1 (0.5%) toggle scheduled in 2m. Executing now...

dev-deploy-bot: Step 1 complete. Cohort IDs: c-001. Sampling logs: https://internal/logs/run-1749298765/step1

Sophie L.: eval job finished: sample 1000, quality delta +0.2% (within threshold). p95 latency +8ms. no 5xx.

Raj P.: telemetry green. proceeding to 5% in 10m unless anyone objects.

Maria G.: proceed. reminder: if any metric crosses gate, call for immediate pin and rollback.

Ops Oncall: saw a transient spike on shard-a at t+6m, normalized at t+9m. keeping watch.

dev-deploy-bot: Step 2 (5%) toggle complete. run-id updated.

Sophie L.: eval after step 2: quality delta +0.9%, p95 +22ms, 5xx rate steady. token-per-request +4%. all within safe bounds.

Taylor H.: updating release notes: "v2.4.1: staged rollout of new-model-routing (feature flag). Ramp schedule and rollback criteria recorded. See run-1749298765 logs." pushing to docs repo.

Raj P.: suggest we add a short canary window at 20% for 30m due to stateful caches. any objections?

Maria G.: agree. extend soak to 30m for step 3. deploy-bot, schedule 30m soak.

dev-deploy-bot: Step 3 (20%) scheduled with 30m soak. Executing now...

Ops Oncall: flag: increased memory use on worker-b during step3, currently +12%. within margin. alerting if >20%.

Sophie L.: eval mid-soak: quality delta +1.1% (ok), p95 +30ms. recommend continue but monitor cache miss rate.

Raj P.: cache-miss spike correlates with worker-b growth, engineering on it but not critical.

Maria G.: ok continue to 100% after soak if no degradation. if cache-miss persists post-20% -> pin and rollback plan executed.

dev-deploy-bot: Step 4 (100%) will start after soak completes at 1749300600.

Taylor H.: added a line in release notes about the canary extension and ops observation. PR: https://git.internal/release-notes/v2.4.1

dev-deploy-bot: Final step executed: 100% toggle complete. Rolling update finished.

Sophie L.: post-deploy eval (sampled 5k): quality delta +0.8%, p95 +28ms, 5xx +0.03% absolute. token-cost +2.5%. no rollback triggers.

Ops Oncall: no pages. closing oncall window at 03:45 UTC.

Raj P.: leaving a follow-up to tune caching strategy for worker-b next sprint.

Maria G.: thanks team. I'll mark feature flag as "rolled-out" in our config and update the customer-facing changelog in the morning. :tada:
